但让我们再读一下推理理由_A：“The paragraph describes the Blahut-Arimoto algorithm and its use in rate-distortion theory, but it does not mention the main paper's contribution or position among existing literature. There is no explicit or implicit statement about how the current work relates to or differs from this prior work. Therefore, it fails to meet the criterion.” 这完全正确。推理理由_B类似。所以都是“支持”。
